_schema.chain: chain id name, e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum
_schema.label: benign | phishing | drainer | unknown
_schema.source: where the label came from (this matters for reproducibility)
_schema.observed_at: ISO date you recorded the label
_schema.notes: free text: family, kit, deployment batch, etc.

_how_to_populate: Benign: well-known verified contracts (stablecoins, DEX routers, major protocols).
Phishing/drainer: block-explorer labels, public research (e.g. ScamSniffer-style writeups),
or your own tracing. NEVER guess a label -- an unverified label poisons the dataset.
Always record the source and the date, because drainers rotate contracts constantly.
